display_long_description:
**Some scrap is worth the risk. You'll find out which.**

Flunklug is a multiplayer co-op horror game about stealing what isn't yours. Break into facilities, caverns and worse with your friends, grab everything of value you can carry, and get out before the things down there catch you first.
# Sell scrap and buy items
Every escape pays for the next. Haul your scraps back out and sell them, unlock new gadgets and weapons, and gear up to push deeper than the run before.
[media]
# Salvage and take scrap
Go deep into a fully physics-driven world where everything reacts, breaks and gets in the way - then grab what you came for while monsters chase you through the dark.
[media]
# Break into new areas
Some parts of the map require special items and gadgets to break or blast your way into. Discover these new places as well as the rarer and luxury-like items inside.
[media]
**Loot the map with up to 15 friends and find new mechanics together**
